text.T007: Code is produced faster, yet work may wait for review, integration or release. My interpretation is that generation, understanding, verification and ownership must be considered together. The Subprime Code Crisis studies that delivery system; it does not assume review is always the constraint.
text.T017: An agent can propose a plausible action while its authority, evidence or recovery path remains unclear. Uncertainty Architecture studies the software system and its wider control perimeter: human roles, operating limits, evidence, decision authority and correction.
text.T023: The repositories are the living sources. Articles are dated author perspectives; their claims and proposed practices need assessment in context.
text.T024: Evidence and limits: an inspectable research synthesis and source library, with proposed operating protocols. Evidence differs across tasks and settings; neither more code nor this synthesis proves a universal productivity effect.
